selector.rationale: The presence of a spiculated lesion with early enhancement peak and architectural distortion on breast MRI, along with the absence of estrogen receptor, progesterone receptor, and HER2/neu expression, supports the diagnosis of triple-negative breast cancer.

rejected.label: Inflammatory breast cancer
rejected.why: Lack of overlying skin changes and axillary lymphadenopathy

rejected.label: Lymphoma of the breast
rejected.why: Epithelial cells were positive for cytokeratin AE1/E3, indicating a carcinoma rather than a lymphoma

rejected.label: Metaplastic breast cancer
rejected.why: While the tumor is triple-negative, there is no specific evidence of metaplastic features
